cover.desc: Full color, warm interior palette — the exact opposite of Ch.1's cover. The Kotobuki-yu changing room at 7pm, bright and crowded and ordinary: rows of yellow plastic baskets, worn wooden floor, the fish clock, a poster curling at one corner. Sōta charges through the foreground with a towel over his head and both arms out, laughing; Mio stands behind him arms folded, unimpressed, hair damp; Itsuki is mid-laugh with a towel round his neck, caught reaching for his brother. Warm yellow lamplight, steam softening the far door. At the right edge, behind the raised bandai counter and slightly higher than everyone, Nagi watches them — happi, hair clipped up, one hand flat on the counter, expression unreadable. The composition puts three people inside the warmth and one person above it, and there is a full basket-width of empty floor between her and them. Nobody is doing anything wrong.

chars.pose: standing on a chair with a textbook balanced on his head

chars.name: gonda

dialogue.text: Behold. Balance. Discipline. A decade of training.

chars.name: itsuki

panels.bg: blurred corridor, motion
panels.action: That is the entire acknowledgement. It lasts half a second.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: stopped, faintly lost, mouth slightly open
chars.pose: half-turned, hand tightening on the strap

panels.bg: corridor, students streaming past her in speed-blur
panels.action: She has no idea what a nod is worth. She has nothing to compare it to.

chars.name: aya
chars.pose: materialising at Nagi's shoulder

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: not turning her head

panels.bg: corridor, lockers
panels.action: Aya has seen everything and understood none of it.

chars.pose: spinning in place, tiny body huge head

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: dot eyes, walking away at speed
chars.pose: leaving the panel entirely

panels.bg: flower screentone, sparkle tone, chaos lines
panels.action: Comedy spike. Aya constructs an entire romance in four seconds and is wrong about all of it.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: her own hand held open in front of her, split knuckles, sleeve pushed back

panels.bg: flat grey screentone
panels.action: Alone at the stairwell window, she looks at her hand for a while. Then pulls the sleeve down.

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu exterior at 6:40pm, Saturday, still light, noren up, a bicycle propped by the door, the shotengai slightly less dead on a weekend
panels.action: Saturday. Opening hours. The version of this building anyone is allowed to see.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: seated high at the bandai counter, textbook open, pen moving, hair clipped up

panels.bg: raised bandai counter, key rack, fish clock, view over both changing rooms
panels.action: She does homework from the counter, the way her grandfather did his crosswords.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: pen still, head lifting

panels.bg: entrance, the noren lifting, three shapes backlit in the doorway
panels.action: The noren lifts. She looks up the way she looks up sixty times a night.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: the public face, dialled all the way up, easy and bright
chars.pose: one hand raised in a casual wave, canvas tote on his shoulder

chars.name: mio
chars.pose: half behind him, arms folded

chars.name: sota
chars.pose: shoes off, sprinting for the sandal rack

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu entrance from inside, evening light behind them, sandal rack, tiled step
panels.action: Full page. Three Nomuras, on a Saturday, at opening hours, like anybody else. It is bright and ordinary and completely wrong.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: one blink too long, then perfectly composed
chars.pose: closing the textbook

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp
panels.action: Half a second where nothing happens on her face. Then the counter voice comes out.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: counting coins onto the counter tray

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: hands folded on the counter

panels.bg: bandai counter from the customer side
panels.action: He pays. He is very good at paying.

dialogue.text: Two kids and one adult. That right?

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: pleasant, making it easy for everyone
chars.pose: scooping change, half a bow

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: seated, still

panels.bg: bandai counter
panels.action: He uses her name with a -san on the end, the way you address a shop.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: hands, motionless, on the countertop

panels.bg: flat grey screentone
panels.action: Silent. She does not correct him. She would not know how.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: reaching past the stacked house towels toward a crate on the low shelf

panels.bg: behind the bandai counter, shelves, the tofu shop's crate of good towels
panels.action: Her hand passes over the thin grey rental towels and goes into Ban's crate instead.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: setting three thick new towels on the counter

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: gathering them up one-handed

panels.bg: bandai counter
panels.action: She gives them the good towels and says nothing about it. This is the only true thing she does all evening.

dialogue.text: Men's side is on the left.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: smile fading by a degree he doesn't notice
chars.pose: stopped two steps from the counter, towels against his chest

panels.bg: changing room, yellow baskets, warm lamp
panels.action: Something in the towels is heavier than it should be. He doesn't work out what. Silent.

chars.name: sota
chars.pose: planted directly in front of the counter, both hands on the ledge

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: leaning back a fraction

panels.bg: bandai counter from below, Sōta's eye level
panels.action: Sōta has decided to conduct an interview.

chars.name: sota
chars.pose: head tilted all the way over

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: a beat of hesitation before answering
chars.pose: very still

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp
panels.action: He asks the question everyone else is too well-mannered to ask.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: smile still on, eyes flat, catchlights gone
chars.pose: stopped dead with the towels, back half-turned

panels.bg: changing room, blurred, Sōta's voice carrying
panels.action: His six-year-old brother just got the truth for free.

chars.name: sota
chars.pose: spinning away toward the bath door

chars.name: mio
chars.pose: grabbing him by the collar

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: seated at the counter

panels.bg: changing room, baskets, warm light
panels.action: To Sōta this is simply the best fact he has ever been told.

chars.name: sota
chars.pose: on tiptoe, posting a 100-yen coin into the massage chair

panels.bg: rest area, ancient vinyl massage chair, faded instruction decal
panels.action: The coin goes in. Nothing at all happens.

chars.name: sota
chars.pose: hammering the chair arm with both fists

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: crouched beside the chair pleading with it

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: chin on hand at the counter

panels.bg: chaos lines, starburst screentone
panels.action: Comedy spike. The chair has eaten money from this family in two generations now.

dialogue.text: Come on. He's SIX. Have some decency.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: flat, sliding a coin across the counter
chars.pose: one hand extended

chars.name: sota
chars.pose: both hands out

panels.bg: bandai counter
panels.action: She refunds a machine that is not hers to refund for, without comment.

dialogue.text: Vending machine's outside. Coffee milk is better anyway.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: seated on a low stool, shoulders and back only, lathering Sōta's hair with both hands

chars.name: sota
chars.pose: seated on a smaller stool, shoulders-up only, foam horn on his head

panels.bg: men's bath hall, washing station, Mt. Fuji mural, HEAVY steam filling the lower two-thirds of the frame — framing is shoulders-up and from behind only, towels visible, no nudity, no fanservice, tender and domestic
panels.action: The one thing he is unambiguously good at, done in a room where nobody is watching him do it.

dialogue.text: Make it a horn. A bigger horn.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: face loose, unguarded, faintly amazed — not performing for anyone
chars.pose: head tipped back, steam on his skin, eyes half closed

panels.bg: steam, tile grid out of focus, single overhead lamp
panels.action: For the first time in the series his face is doing nothing and it isn't grief. He is just warm.

chars.name: sota
chars.pose: shoulders-up in the shallow end, arms on the tile edge

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: shoulders-up beside him, arms folded on the tile

panels.bg: bath hall, heavy steam across the lower frame, mural behind, shoulders-up framing only
panels.action: Sōta reports on a dream he had. It has eleven parts.

dialogue.text: —and then the dog was ALSO the bus.

chars.name: fusae
chars.pose: seated on the tatami bench, empty milk bottle in both hands

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: wiping the counter, not looking up
chars.pose: cloth in hand

panels.bg: rest area, fish clock reading 7:52, warm lamp
panels.action: Fusae-san has been watching the boy since he came in.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: hand flat on the counter

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp
panels.action: She answers with the school version, because it is the version she is allowed to have.

dialogue.text: He's the loudest person in my class.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: gruff, halfway back out the door
chars.pose: thumb jerked toward the street

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: folding the cloth

panels.bg: entrance, noren, night street beyond
panels.action: Ban says a thing and does not explain it. Neither does she.

chars.name: mio

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: restacking baskets

panels.bg: rest area, tatami bench, fish clock, warm lamp
panels.action: Mio comes out first and sits where she can see the counter.

chars.name: mio
chars.pose: picking at the bottle label, not looking up

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: standing very still

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, the men's door closed behind them
panels.action: Mio leaks exactly one true thing, and it is not really about her brother.

dialogue.text: He says it's fine. It's always fine.

chars.name: mio
chars.pose: finally looking straight at her

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: meeting her eyes

panels.bg: flat screentone, warm lamp glow
panels.action: Two people quietly agreeing to protect the same boy from being noticed.

dialogue.text: Don't tell him I said anything.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: pink from the heat, hair damp, genuinely happy
chars.pose: dressed, towel round his neck, carrying a boneless sleepy Sōta on one hip

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: eyes closing, cheek on his brother's shoulder
chars.pose: half asleep, fist knotted in Itsuki's jersey

chars.name: mio
chars.pose: shoving her feet into her shoes

panels.bg: changing room, yellow baskets, warm lamp, steam drifting from the open bath door
panels.action: The Nomuras, warm, clean, and briefly not carrying anything.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: setting two bottles down without being asked
chars.pose: reaching over the counter

chars.name: mio
chars.pose: both hands out

panels.bg: bandai counter, cold case humming
panels.action: Two coffee milks appear on the counter. No transaction is mentioned.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: cold bottle pressed against his palm, Sōta's weight on his other arm

panels.bg: warm lamp, blurred counter

chars.name: itsuki

chars.pose: half-bow at the noren, Sōta asleep on his shoulder

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: seated, back straight

panels.bg: entrance, noren, night street beyond
panels.action: The goodbye a shop gets.

panels.bg: the empty entrance from inside, noren still swinging, three pairs of shoe spaces empty, warm lamp, night street beyond
panels.action: The noren settles. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: completely blank, which is the worst it has looked
chars.pose: seated at the counter, hands still folded exactly as she left them

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp, wide empty room around her
panels.action: She holds the shopkeeper posture for a long time after there is nobody to hold it for.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: reaching up to kill the entrance sign

panels.action: Same shot as last time. Deliberate echo.

chars.name: nagi

chars.pose: on hands and knees scrubbing the same grout line

panels.bg: bath hall, mural, steam, tile grid — compose to match Ch.1 page 8 panel 2

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: sitting on the bath edge, trousers rolled, feet in the water

panels.bg: empty bath hall, heavy steam, one warm lamp, chipped Fuji mural — compose to match Ch.1 page 8 panel 3 exactly. Same frame, and the room has been full since then.
panels.action: The identical panel. It reads completely differently now.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: head lifting a fraction

panels.bg: steam, black void
panels.action: A knock. Two, then a pause, then one more.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: walking barefoot through the empty bath hall toward the front, wet footprints behind her

panels.bg: long view through the bath hall to the changing room and the entrance, steam, one lamp, a silhouette outside the frosted glass

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: fingers on the door frame

panels.bg: frosted glass door, warm light, a shape beyond it
panels.action: One beat of hesitation. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: out of breath, hair a mess, nothing performing on his face
chars.pose: standing on the step in his jersey, empty-handed, hands loose at his sides

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: one hand still on the door she has just slid open

panels.action: He came back after the kids were asleep. He is carrying nothing, which is the point.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: small, plain, completely open — none of his usual size
chars.pose: shoulders lifting once with breath

panels.bg: night, warm doorway light, steam curling past him
panels.action: He has been carrying this line since Tuesday.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — silhouette in the doorway
chars.pose: standing back, hand sliding the door wider

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — small, on the step
chars.pose: still standing outside

panels.bg: wide exterior of the shuttered street at midnight, clear sky, one warm doorway open on a dead road, steam pouring out into the cold
panels.action: The door goes wider. Nothing else happens on the page.
